sourceBasisProvenance.hashesWhat: executable PATH STRINGS (not contents, not a signed manifest)
sourceBasisProvenance.note: the P2-B cold gate supplies Process A's own sourceBasis to Process B, so it establishes VALUE MATCHING, not independent recovery of the verifier's trusted configuration

sourceKindEnforcement.note: sourceKind is persisted but the qualifier never reads it, so a CONTROLLED_STUB record with a matching basis is not distinguished

durableRecordIntegrity.note: the store validates the payload SHAPE and the projectId, but not that eventId equals the canonical identity, nor that the SQLite columns agree with the payload

workRevalidation.note: the port only requires a non-null Attempt record; it does not verify the exact historical ATTEMPT_CREATED event identity

observationWindow.note: finalization is recorded from the delegation boundary returning; the port itself distinguishes close/exit/timeout/abort, but the delegation closeReason collapses them into INVOCATION_RETURNED

handoffAdmission.note: events are gated on the admission FLAG, but there is no validator that refuses an internally contradictory combination of binding status, session id and admission

untrustedAssociations.note: the resolver accepts any association object carrying those three fields; nothing binds the OBJECT to a durable store, so a caller-built object can satisfy it
untrustedAssociations.productionBoundaryNeeded: the product adapter must obtain associations from the durable read side, never from a caller-supplied array

productComposition.note: the host derives a BRANCH port but not a WORK worker port; the install composes neither the association concern nor a trajectory surface

previewDigest.note: the digest covers execution events and identity but not the read watermark or known event count, so an observation-basis change can leave the digest unchanged

readerProductization.note: the official reader lives under scripts/ and is imported only by tests; no src/ module imports a .mjs script today
